raw_prompt: !create add a new item. Call it a bullet proof vest. and make it so that if any projectile (arrows, etc) hits the player, they don't do damage. Vanilla Skript only
reviewer_feedback: Created a Bullet Proof Vest item that negates projectile damage using lore-based identification.
usage_instructions: Use /givevest to obtain the Bullet Proof Vest.
Equip the vest in your chestplate slot to block all projectiles.

mutations.content:
command /givevest:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        set {_vest} to iron chestplate named "&bBullet Proof Vest"
        set line 1 of lore of {_vest} to "&7Vest"
        give {_vest} to player

on damage of player:
    if projectile exists:
        if victim's chestplate is not air:
            if line 1 of lore of victim's chestplate is "&7Vest":
                cancel event
                send "&aYour vest absorbed the impact!" to victim

traces.intent_summary: Create a bullet proof vest item that negates damage from projectiles when worn.

traces.rationale: The script uses the 'on damage' event to intercept projectile damage. It checks for the existence of a projectile and verifies the presence of a custom NBT tag on the player's chestplate to determine if the damage should be negated. This approach is efficient and avoids unnecessary overhead.

This is the standard, stable way to identify custom items in pure Skript without requiring additional plugins.
